[EN] Just passing through, eh?

I'm guessing you're on a mission, or you wouldn't be in such a hurry.

I tell you what: Let's have a riddle contest. If you win, I'll let you pass.
[ES] ¿Solo de paso, eh?

Supongo que estás en una misión, o no tendrías tanta prisa.

Te propongo algo: hagamos un concurso de acertijos. Si ganas, te dejaré pasar.

[EN] Ha! What a tough customer you are! Very well."I don't have time for this." "Just open the door already."
[ES] ¡Ja! ¡Qué cliente tan duro eres! Muy bien."I don't have time for this." "Just open the door already."

[EN] Okay, just a moment. I'll open the door for you.
[ES] De acuerdo, solo un momento. Te abriré la puerta.

[EN] You'd better watch your back.
[ES] Más te vale cuidar tus espaldas.
